🎯 Nonogram

Number clues on each row and column indicate how many consecutive cells are filled. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Read the number clues — they show how many consecutive cells are filled in that row/column.
  2. Multiple numbers in a clue mean groups are separated by at least one empty cell.
  3. Use X to mark cells you know are definitely empty.
  4. Cross-reference row and column clues to narrow down possibilities.
  5. Fill in cells when you're certain — wrong marks make the puzzle harder.
